value.signature: fn poll_read (self : Pin < & mut Self > , cx : & mut Context < '_ > , buf : & mut ReadBuf < '_ >) -> Poll < io :: Result < () > >

exception.justification: Justified: Connection plumbing inside the instrumented RPC read; per-read observation would record transport fragments rather than public outcomes.

review.body: { let this = self . get_mut () ; let mut watch = this . watch . borrow_mut () ; if watch . refusal . is_some () { return Poll :: Ready (Err (refused ())) ; } match watch . phase { Phase :: Body => Pin :: new (& mut this . stream) . poll_read (cx , buf) , Phase :: Held => { watch . waker = Some (cx . waker () . clone ()) ; Poll :: Pending } Phase :: Head if buf . remaining () == 0 => Poll :: Ready (Ok (())) , Phase :: Head => { let mut bytes = [0 ; 4] ; let want = watch . want () . min (buf . remaining ()) ; let mut head = ReadBuf :: new (& mut bytes [.. want]) ; ready ! (Pin :: new (& mut this . stream) . poll_read (cx , & mut head)) ? ; for byte in head . filled () { match watch . admit (* byte) { Ok (false) => { } Ok (true) => watch . phase = Phase :: Held , Err (refusal) => { watch . refusal = Some (refusal) ; return Poll :: Ready (Err (refused ())) ; } } } buf . put_slice (head . filled ()) ; Poll :: Ready (Ok (())) } } }
review.item_premise: This body moves received response bytes, public service data under the rpc-bounds amendment, from the owned socket to the parser: head bytes pass only through the raw-wire watch, at most up to the head terminator, and body reads wait until the head is admitted. It holds no connection detail or credential, and its refusals are typed causes recorded by the enclosing read.
